subject: general
question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

53, 54, 50, 59, 43, ?
solution:
**Logic : Squares of consecutive numbers is alternately added to and then subtracted from each number subsequently.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5718dfaab692838888a56f92bf07b01e3f81d103939f41c6e148a994db5d2e8e.png] 

Hence, **"68"** is the correct answer.
